fixture: Committed Worn Painted Metal on assigned default cube
precision: Full float32 authored and live GPU textures
timing_scope: Property mutation, production cache.tick event scheduling and cooperative yields, native dependency processing, first current-revision VIEW_3D rendering and 3x3 framebuffer completion fence; not physical presentation or OS input latency.
limits: Production cache.tick remains registered and alone advances live jobs. The prepare phase measures property mutation; scheduler work, native dependency updates and draw/fence are combined in the following wait phase.
Cold starts with fixture and authored images created; fixture creation is reported separately.
The cold result ends at the first native draw, which may still have asynchronous shader compilation pending.
Warm edits follow at least two seconds and taa_samples+4 native warmup draws after cold publication.
Each warm measurement fences the first subsequent native draw; later temporal refinement is excluded.
The 3x3 patch verifies finite, nonempty opaque shaded color after warmup and fences GPU work, not full-image pixel parity.
PRE_VIEW captures Blender's color framebuffer; POST_PIXEL reads that target explicitly because the active post-pixel target contains only overlays.
Normal EEVEE temporal reprojection remains enabled if supplied by factory settings.
The actual window/region size and ordinary Blender event-loop scheduling affect these timings.
Cold fixture evaluation is held during initial viewport warmup by temporarily clearing only ts.dirty, then released at the timed cold submission.

Scheduler completion timestamps are observations at a harness poll or native draw start, not instrumentation inside cache.tick; total edit-to-frame includes all scheduling and cooperative-yield delay.

Procedural phases follow the uniform-edit phases with their final folder opacity and roughness retained. Mask strength changes the active inverted CHIPS mask; source scale changes the shared ORANGE_PEEL field on Base Color, Roughness and Height in one callback. Texture resolution and precision remain unchanged.
